text: The Patriots face the Jaguars in Week 3 dealing with some notable absences on the defensive line, as OLB Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and rookie LB Quintayvious Hutchins (knee) are ruled out, with Hutchins now on injured reserve, though CB Carlton Davis III is set to return from his injury. On a more encouraging note, rookie TE Eli Raridon has returned to practice, offering some optimism about his availability for Sunday's contest. Meanwhile, the Jaguars enter the matchup expecting a favorable response after their worst offensive performance in eleven months, and the Patriots will need to be sharp in clock management after struggling with late-second-quarter decisions in their past two games. The Patriots' roster situation and situational execution could prove decisive against a Jacksonville team hungry to bounce back.
